claim: The user guide's IPv4 and IPv6 comparison gives a VPC up to 5 IPv6 CIDRs from /44 to /60 in increments of /4, against up to 5 IPv4 CIDRs from /16 to /28; both quotas are adjustable.
question: What IPv6 CIDR sizes does the user guide allow for a VPC?

values.display: Up to 5 CIDRs from /44 to /60 in increments of /4
values.spoken: up to five IPv6 CIDRs, from slash forty-four to slash sixty
up to five IPv4 CIDRs, from slash sixteen to slash twenty-eight

note: Conflicts with the FAQ (vpc-faq-ipv6-vpc-fixed-56), which still says a fixed /56.
